## Lineage

**Mykolas Kęsgaila** (Kieżgajło, d. 1450), son of Valimantas, was elder of Samogitia 1412–32, 1440–41 and 1443–50 (terms to verify). His brothers the **Valimantaičiai**, among them **Rumbaudas Valimantaitis**, were Vytautas's men in Samogitia c. 1409–11 and the bridge between Vilnius and the Samogitian assemblies. Kęsgaila was Švitrigaila's man, imprisoned by Žygimantas after 1432 and restored in 1440. [Record, verify offices]

## Feuds & alliances

Servants of the Grand Duchy ([GDL](../factions/gdl.qmd)) and kin of the [Samogitians](../factions/samogitians.qmd). Opposed to Žygimantas; part of the council that made Casimir Grand Duke.

## Fate across the books

- **III:** Rumbaudas Valimantaitis is POV in ch. 12 of the second Samogitian rising (1409).
- **IV:** the Samogitian baptism (1413–17) and Melno (1422) fix the land's fate.
- **V:** the Kęsgailos are one of the council houses in ch. 17 and share in the power that unmakes Žygimantas. As the groves fall, the family is a man between two orders. [Record, saga framing]
